headline: Today's Gold Price (9-9): Domestic Gold Edges Up, World Gold Falls Sharply
summary: SJC gold bar prices in Vietnam reversed and rose to 146.6 million VND per tael on the sell side. World spot gold fell sharply at the end of Tuesday's US afternoon session.
why: Spot gold is the global benchmark price for the metal, and domestic prices in Vietnam can diverge from it due to local market conditions.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: World spot gold fell sharply in the US trading session, the global reference for the metal.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
